summary: Bound remote response buffering, reject credential-bearing redirect downgrades, and support stdin token storage.
reason: Unbounded responses could exhaust a long-lived MCP host, same-host HTTPS-to-HTTP redirects could expose API keys, and positional token setup leaked secrets through argv.
validated_outcome: Fixed-length and chunked oversize, normalized-origin redirect, TLS downgrade, and non-echoing stdin token tests pass.
